nodes.name: Alchemy Station
nodes.description: Unlocks the Alchemy Station for the Guild Outpost, enabling potion brewing and medicine crafting.

nodes.name: Cooking Station
nodes.description: Unlocks the Cooking Station for the Guild Outpost, enabling recipe discovery, food preparation, and cooking.

nodes.name: Blacksmithing Station
nodes.description: Unlocks the Blacksmithing Station for the Guild Outpost, enabling ore smelting and weapon forging.

nodes.name: Armorsmithing Bench
nodes.description: Unlocks the Armorsmithing Bench for the Guild Outpost, enabling hide tailoring and silk weaving into armor.

nodes.name: Digging
nodes.description: Unlocks excavation and dig spots in dungeons, uncovering buried resources, soil, and curiosities.

nodes.name: Harvest Enemy Skin
nodes.description: Unlocks Skinning, allowing pelts, hides, and silk to be harvested from animal corpses in dungeons.

nodes.name: Harvest Enemy Meat
nodes.description: Unlocks Butchering, allowing raw meat to be carved from eligible non-undead corpses in dungeons.

nodes.name: Bowyer Station
nodes.description: Unlocks the Bowyer Station for the Guild Outpost, enabling the crafting and shaping of wooden bows and strings.

nodes.name: Gardening
nodes.description: Unlocks planting plots for cultivating crops in the Outpost and begins the study of agriculture.

nodes.name: Fishing
nodes.description: Unlocks fishing spots in dungeon water bodies, allowing fish and aquatic reagents to be gathered.

nodes.name: Magical Crafting
nodes.description: Unlocks the Magical Weapon Station for the Guild Outpost, enabling magical crystal cutting and staff enchantment.

nodes.name: Woodworking Bench
nodes.description: Unlocks the Woodworking Bench for the Guild Outpost, enabling plank milling and fine timber furniture crafting.

nodes.name: Stonemason's Yard
nodes.description: Unlocks the Stonemason's Yard for the Guild Outpost, enabling stone cutting, brick masonry, and grand architectural works.

nodes.name: Plank Construction
nodes.description: Unlocks plank floors, walls and doors in Build Mode. Planks are milled from wood at the Woodworking Bench.

nodes.name: Stone Construction
nodes.description: Unlocks stone floors and walls in Build Mode, built from quarried stone.

nodes.name: Brick Construction
nodes.description: Unlocks brick floors and walls in Build Mode. Bricks are fired from stone and clay at the Stonemason's Yard.

nodes.name: Reinforced Construction
nodes.description: Unlocks iron-braced reinforced walls and doors in Build Mode. Reinforced planks and bricks are forged at the Blacksmithing Station.

nodes.name: Runic Construction
nodes.description: Unlocks rune-etched walls and doors in Build Mode. Runic planks and bricks are enchanted at the Magical Weapon Station.

nodes.name: Taming
nodes.description: Unlocks the ability to pacify and tame wild creatures in dungeons.

nodes.name: Animal Husbandry
nodes.description: Unlocks construction of Animal Pens at the outpost to shelter and tend livestock for daily goods.
